meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或脚本变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手握产品链接或脚本,想要现成的发布宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product link and want a ready-made launch video.

howto.what: Claude 会先把你的产品官网链接、粘贴的文案或简报变成宣传或发布视频:抓取网页素材和品牌色,写分镜与旁白,最后渲染成 MP4 成片。网站导览类请求会照真实网页截图呈现;开工前会先问你是否要更新技能。
howto.when: 当你想做产品宣传、发布或推广视频,或直接给出商业产品网址时触发。只说“做个视频”而意图不明时,会先由 /hyperframes 判断路由;网站导览类请求也归这里。

say.text: 把我的产品官网链接做成一分钟宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会抓取页面素材并渲染成片。

say.text: 这是产品功能简介文字,帮我做条短视频。
say.note: 按简介直接走,不再抓网页。

say.text: 做一段官网展示视频,按页面原样展示。
say.note: 走网站导览路径,用真实截图当素材。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a promo/launch video: captures site assets/brand cues, writes storyboard and narration, then renders frames to final MP4. Site tours show captured screens as-is.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a product promo, launch, or reveal video, or paste any commercial product URL. Vague 'make a video' asks or unclear intents get routed through /hyperframes first. Site-tour requests also land here.

say_en.text: Turn my product landing page into a one-minute promo video.
say_en.note: Captures the site and renders the video.

say_en.text: Here is the product copy; make a short promo video.
say_en.note: Uses the text directly; no web scraping.

say_en.text: Make a site-tour video for our site, showing pages as they are.
say_en.note: Goes down the site-tour route; real screenshots as base.
